reply: Thank you for explaining that a $700.00 charge was made in a place you had not visited, and that it was credited, charged again and then treated as legitimate. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please send a written dispute that includes your police report number and the date you first reported the charge, and keep checking your statements for any further charges. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your store card credit limit was reduced because of a late payment that was later corrected on your credit reports. We understand how this affects your credit use. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including whether the limit decision can be looked at again. Please keep the corrected credit report and your payment records, and ask in writing for the reason for the reduction. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that someone posing as fraud staff obtained your login details and verification code, and that $1,800.00 was then taken from your account. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team under your claim. Please change your password, keep your claim number and any call records, and remember that genuine staff never ask for your password or codes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card was cancelled during an online chat when you did not realize which card was being closed, and that it has not been reinstated. We understand how quickly this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including your request to reinstate the card. Please keep a copy of the chat transcript and a note of your call right afterwards. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card account has not been classified under the Military Lending Act for several years, despite repeated requests while you are on active duty. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the servicemember team, including any interest or fees charged. Please keep proof of your active-duty status and a list of your contacts. The Act limits certain charges for covered servicemembers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining the long series of steps you have taken to receive the refund of a duplicate balance transfer payment, including a notarized affidavit, without receiving the money. We are sorry for how long this has taken. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep a copy of the affidavit, the case manager's details and the dates of each visit. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that interest was charged after a payment error, even though you then paid your balance in full. We understand your concern about how trailing interest was applied. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the $23.00 interest charge. Please keep your statements for these months and the dates of your payments. Your cardholder agreement explains when interest applies after a late payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your $490.00 payment was declined, and that you have not been given proof or a full account history. We understand why you want this documented. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep your bank records for the payment date, and ask in writing for the payment history and the reason the payment did not complete. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told the disputed amount would be removed in 14 days, that an internal error delayed it, and that it still has not been removed. We understand your worry about your credit while you plan to buy a home. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written billing dispute if you have not already, and keep a record of your calls and the dates you were given. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged an annual fee despite being told you would be covered under the Military Lending Act, and that your requests have not been reviewed in full. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the servicemember team. Please keep the documents showing your active-duty status and the fee charges. The Act limits certain fees and charges for covered servicemembers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that an account you never applied for has not been closed as you were told, and that you did not receive the earlier written response. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including the closure date. Please keep the email about the closure date and the screenshot of your call, and ask for written confirmation once the account is closed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a late payment was reported on your account even though you always pay on time, and how much this is worrying you. We understand. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. A payment received by the cut-off time on the due date should not be treated as late, so please gather the payment confirmations for the month in question. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a card was opened in your name with a $16,000.00 credit line that you did not apply for, and that you could not stop it being issued. We understand how alarming this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please do not activate any card that arrives, ask for written confirmation of closure, and review your credit reports for other activity. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your new card was closed after two months because of a past account closure, even though you have paid on time. We understand your concern about your credit score. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Card issuers can close accounts, but you can ask in writing for the specific reason and keep the letter you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your credit builder card shows a $560.00 balance and late payments, even though it works like a prepaid card where you can only spend what you deposit. We understand why this is confusing. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep your deposit and spending history, and ask in writing for a breakdown of how the balance was calculated. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about four hard inquiries on your credit report that you did not make. We understand your concern about identity theft. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep a copy of your Federal Trade Commission report, and review your credit reports regularly for new accounts or inquiries you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about a hard inquiry on your credit report for an application you never made, after your information was misused before. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including whether an account was opened. Please keep your fraud alert in place and look for charges or accounts you do not recognize on your statements and credit reports. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told you do not qualify for the bonus miles because of a timing rule you did not see when applying, and that another bonus was not credited. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including both bonuses. Please keep screenshots of the application page and the offer terms you saw, and the email response you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card was closed while you were waiting for a replacement after losing your wallet, and that you were given three different reasons. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including whether the account can be restored without a new credit check. Please keep a note of each call. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you have not been able to transfer your rewards points to your travel loyalty program through the app, despite several calls. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the rewards team. Please note any error messages you see in the app and the loyalty program number you are using, and keep a record of your calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that payments were attempted from an account you had not selected, that your provisional credit was reversed, and that your account was closed without notice. We are sorry for the embarrassment of a declined card. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the dispute outcome. Please keep your credit union's confirmation and screenshots of your payment settings. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $530.00 credit for an item returned to the seller has been reversed onto your balance a second time. We understand how stressful it is to keep calling. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written dispute that names the charge and both dates it was added, and keep proof that the item was returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your scheduled autopay was cancelled when the store card changed providers, leading to fees and negative reporting. We understand your frustration that autopay cannot be set up by phone. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the fees. Please keep records of your earlier autopay setup and the fee notices, and confirm your payment method each month for now. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account you never opened was set up in your name, and that a settlement check was sent to an old address and cashed by someone else. We understand how frustrating the repeated forms have been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep copies of every form and acknowledgment letter, and dispute the unknown account with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your requests for Military Lending Act protections were denied twice, even after you uploaded proof of your service. We understand your frustration with the responses. Your complaint has been logged for review by the servicemember team. Please keep your eligibility certificate and the dates of your requests. There are laws that limit the interest rate charged to active-duty servicemembers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged $270.00 for fuel when your receipt shows $74.00, and that your dispute was closed in the merchant's favor twice. We understand why you want to see the reasons. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the receipt, the station's confirmation and your messages, and ask in writing for the evidence the decision relied on. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a late fee was not reduced as you were told, that more fees were added after you asked to close the account, and that the total is now $60.00. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the closure date and fees. Please keep your bill pay confirmation and the closure letter. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $51.00 gift card was never received and that your dispute was closed in the merchant's favor. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your order confirmation and a note of your call with the merchant, and contest the decision in writing so the dispute can be reviewed again. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card applications were declined for different reasons, most recently because your information could not be verified. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. When an application is declined because of a credit report, the lender must send you a notice of the reason, so ask for it in writing and review your reports. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a card closed months ago has reopened with a balance and five late payments on your credit report, after your bankruptcy. We understand how damaging this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the reporting. Please keep your discharge papers and the closure confirmation, and check your credit reports for other errors. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
